title: An integrated analysis of lactylation signature reveals PRDX1 as a therapeutic target of keloid pathogenesis.
authors: He, Ruizhe; Sun, Mengzhe; Liu, Tiantian; Peng, Yinbo; Peng, Linbo; Fang, Yong
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合转录组与机器学习分析乳酰化修饰在瘢痕疙瘩发病中的作用，虽涉及转录因子调控网络预测，但核心为疾病靶点与免疫微环境，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Keloids represent a pathological fibroproliferative disorder with high recurrence rates and limited therapeutic options. This study integrates multi-dataset transcriptomics (GSE158395, GSE188952, GSE92566, GSE173900) and machine learning algorithms (XGBoost, Random Forest, LASSO) to systematically investigate the role of lactylation modification in keloid pathogenesis. We identified 26 lactylation-related differentially expressed genes (15 upregulated, 11 downregulated) enriched in oxidative stress, immune response, and extracellular matrix pathways. Machine learning convergence revealed five lactylation hub genes (PRDX1, CSRP1, IFI16, CALD1, VIM), with PRDX1 exhibiting the highest diagnostic efficacy (AUC = 0.85). Immune infiltration analysis demonstrated significant correlations between hub genes and dysregulated immune cells. Experimental validation confirmed reduced PRDX1 expression in keloid tissues; its knockdown in fibroblasts elevated ROS levels and enhanced proliferation and migration. Regulatory network analysis predicted shared transcription factors (KLF12, NFKB1, MYC) governing hub genes, while drug screening prioritized three clinically actionable compounds (acetaminophen, valproic acid, vorinostat) targeting PRDX1. These findings establish lactylation as a critical regulator of keloid pathogenesis and identify PRDX1 as a promising therapeutic target.
abstract_zh: 瘢痕疙瘩是一种病理性纤维增生性疾病，具有高复发率和有限的治疗选择。本研究整合多数据集转录组学（GSE158395、GSE188952、GSE92566、GSE173900）和机器学习算法（XGBoost、Random Forest、LASSO），系统探讨乳酸化修饰在瘢痕疙瘩发病机制中的作用。我们鉴定了26个乳酸化相关差异表达基因（15个上调，11个下调），富集于氧化应激、免疫反应和细胞外基质通路。机器学习收敛性分析揭示了五个乳酸化核心基因（PRDX1、CSRP1、IFI16、CALD1、VIM），其中PRDX1表现出最高的诊断效能（AUC = 0.85）。免疫浸润分析显示核心基因与失调免疫细胞之间存在显著相关性。实验验证确认瘢痕疙瘩组织中PRDX1表达降低；其在成纤维细胞中的敲低升高了ROS水平并增强了增殖和迁移能力。调控网络分析预测了调控核心基因的共享转录因子（KLF12、NFKB1、MYC），而药物筛选优先确定了三种靶向PRDX1的临床可行化合物（对乙酰氨基酚、丙戊酸、伏立诺他）。这些发现确立了乳酸化作为瘢痕疙瘩发病机制的关键调控因子，并确定PRDX1为有前景的治疗靶点。
